transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I came in because I just don’t really care about things I used to enjoy. Dance class, hiking, trying new recipes, game night… they all feel like chores now, like things I keep putting off. I don’t feel much like myself.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
Yeah… most days I feel this low, sour feeling under everything. It’s not always exactly “sad,” but it’s like fear and guilt are just sitting there, even when nothing bad is happening.
Have you lost interest in activities you used to enjoy, like dance class, hiking, or trying new recipes?
Yes. I barely care about them now. Dance class, hiking, trying new recipes… even game night. They used to feel like me, but now they just feel like chores I keep putting off.
Have you been feeling like you’re not worth anything, or been blaming yourself for things that aren’t your fault?

Yeah. I keep going over it in my head, like I should’ve known better than to take that booking. And I feel like I failed the people who were helping me… like I didn’t keep them safe, even though I know maybe that’s not fair.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Since the robbery at that festival job… so, about two years and three months now.
Have you had a depressed mood or lost interest in activities almost every day for at least two years?

Yes. It’s been almost every day. I barely care about the things that used to make me feel like myself—dance class, hiking, trying new recipes, even game night. They just kind of sit there now, like chores I keep putting off.
Have you been feeling more tired or lacking energy, even when you haven’t done much physically or mentally?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I get tired sometimes, but I haven’t noticed it being a big thing or happening even when I haven’t done much.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or weight over the past two years?
Not really. My appetite goes up and down like anyone’s, I guess, but I haven’t noticed a big weight change or anything that feels significant.
Have you had trouble sleeping, or have you found yourself sleeping a lot more than usual?
I’m not sure. My sleep isn’t perfect all the time, but I haven’t really noticed a big change like sleeping way more than usual or having serious trouble with it.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, have you felt restless or fidgety, like you can’t sit still?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t noticed myself moving or talking slower, and I’m not really fidgety or unable to sit still either.
Have you noticed a decrease in your interest or participation in other activities, even small things like going out with friends or watching your favorite shows?

Yeah. That’s actually a big part of why I came in. I just don’t really care about things I used to enjoy—dance class, hiking, trying new recipes, game night. Even small stuff like that feels like a chore now, so I keep putting it off.
Would you say that, for most of the day, on more days than not, you have been feeling persistently down or depressed?

Yeah, most days I feel pretty low. It’s not always like crying or anything, but there’s this kind of heavy, sour feeling underneath everything—fear and guilt, mostly—even when nothing is actually happening. It’s there a lot of the day.
Do you still find any pleasure or satisfaction in activities you used to enjoy, like dance class, hiking, or trying new recipes, or does it feel like you don’t get anything out of them anymore?

I don’t really get much out of them anymore. Those were the things that used to make me feel like myself—dance class, hiking, cooking, game night—but now they just feel like chores I keep putting off.
Have you noticed that you're moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the contrary, feeling restless or unable to sit still, even when you're not trying to?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed myself moving or talking slower, and I don’t think I’m pacing around or anything like that. If it’s happening, it’s not something I’ve picked up on.
Would you say that you’ve completely lost the ability to feel pleasure or enjoyment in most activities, even the ones you used to really like?

I don’t know if I’d say completely lost it, but it’s pretty close. I barely care about the things I used to really like—dance, hiking, cooking new recipes, game night. They just kind of sit there now, like chores I keep avoiding.
Have you noticed a big drop in how much you care about or take part in activities, even things you used to enjoy like dance class, hiking, or game night?

Yes. I’ve noticed a big drop. I barely care about the stuff that used to feel like me—dance class, hiking, trying new recipes, even game night. It all just kind of sits there now, like chores I keep putting off.
Would you say that most days, you feel like you can’t enjoy or take pleasure in anything, even things you used to really like?

Most days, yeah, it feels like I can’t really enjoy much. The things that used to make me feel like myself—dance class, hiking, cooking something new, game night—they just kind of sit there now, like chores I keep putting off.
